Title: Molecular maps based on broadly learned knowledge-based representations
Description: Lays out 1,369 physicochemical descriptors as a two-dimensional map, the descriptor counterpart to the fingerprint-based variant from the same work. Feature positions come from clustering 1,456 descriptors by their correlation across 8.5 million molecules, so that chemically related quantities occupy neighbouring pixels and local convolution filters see coherent information. The representation is designed as input to image models rather than for direct reading, and individual pixels are not meaningful in isolation.
Interpretation: Descriptor-based molecular map arranged as a 37 by 37 image for convolutional models.
